channel.title: Retirement Plan Karo Blog
channel.description: Retirement and money guides for India

item.title: VPF mein ₹5,000 extra daalein to retirement par kitna fayda? Pura hisaab
item.description: VPF kya hai, kaise shuru karein aur ₹2,000 se ₹10,000 mahina extra daalne par 10, 20, 30 saal mein kitna banta hai. 8.25% rate par simple table.

item.title: Emergency Fund kitna hona chahiye? 3, 6 ya 9 mahine ka simple hisaab
item.description: Emergency fund kitna rakhein, kahan rakhein aur kaise banayein? Salaried family ke liye 3-6-9 mahine ki table, RD se banane ka plan aur common galtiyan.

item.title: PPF mein 15 saal mein kitna milega? ₹12,000 se ₹1.5 lakh tak ka pura hisaab
item.description: PPF mein har saal paisa daalne par 15, 20 aur 25 saal baad kitna banega? 7.1% rate par table, 5 tareekh ka rule aur extension ka simple hisaab.

item.title: 1 Crore ke liye kitna SIP karna padega? 10, 15, 20, 25 saal ki table
item.description: 1 crore banane ke liye monthly SIP kitni chahiye? 10%, 12% return par 10 se 25 saal ki simple table, examples aur galtiyan jo log karte hain.
